reviews.comment: i took chem 315 with him. by far one of the worst professors i've ever had. asks for feedback but then gets defensive when provided with feedback. homework is assigned 5 days before the deadline. content of quizzes is unpredictable. overall, avoid this professor if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Cai was super nice and helpful in lab. His TA is a harsh grader but they both ensured that the course was exceptionally organized and conducted with the single goal of helping the students learn. My favorite lab simply because of my experience with Dr. Cai and Fan.

This class was average. The labs are graded on accuracy mostly so make sure to take your time with experiments (one bad grade can really hurt). There were only 7 labs so we finished the class the first week of November. Reports were graded fast because they just grade mainly accuracy. The group project was canceled but the final exam was rough.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things
